en: Get out of my way!
zh: 别挡我的路！
speaker: Yzma

en: Come on. Come on out.
zh: 快点，出来吧。
speaker: Bob Parr / Mr. Incredible

en: We should get out of here.
zh: 我们该离开这儿了。
speaker: Hiro Hamada

en: Great. Let's get out of here.
zh: 太好了。我们走吧。
speaker: Bonnie’s dad

en: Let me out!
zh: 放我出去！
speaker: Moana

en: Stay out of sight, Olaf.
zh: 奥拉夫，躲好，别让人看见。
speaker: Kristoff

en: Ray! Get me out of this box!
zh: 雷！把我从这个盒子里救出来！
speaker: Prince Naveen

en: Molly, stay out of my room!
zh: 莫莉，别进我的房间！
speaker: Andy

en: Okay. Out of the box. Everyone, right now!
zh: 好了。都从盒子里出来。所有人，马上！
speaker: Woody

en: Somebody! Anybody! Please let me out!
zh: 来人啊！谁都行！请放我出去！
speaker: Fix-It Felix Jr.

en: No, no, no, no, no. Outta gas? How can I be outta gas?
zh: 不不不……没油了？我怎么会没油了？
speaker: Lightning McQueen

en: I'm running out of time. It's Coco.
zh: 我快没时间了。是可可（她正在忘记我）。
speaker: Héctor

en: We're both out of time, mijo.
zh: 我们俩都没时间了，孩子。
speaker: Héctor

en: You're running out of air.
zh: 你快没空气了。
speaker: Wade Ripple

en: It looks like you're out of ideas.
zh: 看起来你已经没招了。
speaker: Shan Yu

en: We've run out of land.
zh: 陆地已经走完了。
speaker: Valentino

en: We're running out of time.
zh: 我们快没时间了。
speaker: Joe Gardner

en: Regrettably, we are all out of wine.
zh: 很遗憾，酒已经没有了。
speaker: Chef Skinner

en: No, but we're running out of time.
zh: 不是，但我们快没时间了。
speaker: Pongo or Perdita

en: She was running out of time.
zh: 她快没时间了。
speaker: Narrator (opening)

en: This is getting out of hand.
zh: 这已经越来越失控了。
speaker: King Agnarr

en: Luisa's losing her powers. Isabela's out of control.
zh: 路易莎的能力正在消失。伊莎贝拉已经失控了。
speaker: Abuela Alma

en: We're calling this ‘controlling what you can when things feel out of control.’
zh: 我们把这叫作：当事情让人觉得失控时，只去掌控你能掌控的。
speaker: Olaf

en: I had a dream that Dad was tied to a log and was careening out of control down a raging river of death!
zh: 我梦见爸爸被绑在一根木头上，失控地冲进一条要命的急流里！
speaker: Chicha (Pacha's wife) — family/home scene, recounting a nightmare

en: She's out of control. She's out of control.
zh: 她失控了。她失控了。
speaker: Li Shang (the line is spoken twice)

en: She's out of control!
zh: 她失控了！
speaker: Ming Lee

en: So, things got a little out of hand downstairs.
zh: 楼下刚才有点失控了。
speaker: Riley’s dad

en: So, things haven't spiraled out of control the moment I left?
zh: 事情并没有在我一离开就失控吧？
speaker: Helen Parr / Elastigirl (phone call home)

en: Charles, this is getting out of hand.
zh: 查尔斯，这已经越来越失控了。
speaker: Annabel Andrews (in her mother Ellen’s body), to Principal Charles Dilk — live-action Disney

en: Is blazing in me out of all control
zh: 在我心里燃烧，完全失控了。
speaker: Quasimodo, in the song “Heaven’s Light” (sung line; faster-whisper clearly heard “out of all control”)

en: Does this mean we can come out of hiding?
zh: 这是不是说，我们可以不用再躲起来了？
speaker: Bob Parr / Mr. Incredible

en: Let it in, let it out, let it rain, let it snow, let it go.
zh: 让它进来，让它出去，让它下雨，让它下雪，让它去吧。
speaker: Family ensemble in “We Don't Talk About Bruno” (Pepa / Félix / chorus)

en: You can come out now.
zh: 你可以出来了。
speaker: Asha

en: And a lot of us never let it out.
zh: 而且我们很多人从来都没把它释放出来。
speaker: Grandma Wu

en: It feels so good to let it out. So free.
zh: 把它释放出来的感觉真好。好自由。
speaker: Grandma Wu

en: So now the truth comes out, doesn't it?
zh: 这么说，真相终于出来了，对不对？
speaker: Mike Wazowski

en: Puppies, come on out. Come out wherever you are.
zh: 小狗们，出来吧。不管你们躲在哪儿，都出来吧。
speaker: Jasper Badun

en: Come on out. It's okay.
zh: 出来吧。没关系的。
speaker: Jessie

en: Come on out!
zh: 出来吧！
speaker: Poppa Henry

en: Come on out, Bambi.
zh: 出来吧，小鹿斑比。
speaker: Bambi’s mother

en: No, I know we can figure this out together.
zh: 不，我知道我们能一起把这件事弄明白。
speaker: Anna

en: What? I figured it out.
zh: 什么？我想出来了。
speaker: Moana (“What?”) and Maui (“I figured it out.”)

en: We're gonna find out!
zh: 我们会弄清楚的！
speaker: Mirabel

en: I figured it out for myself.
zh: 我自己想出来的。
speaker: Belle

en: You ready, rookie? Let's find out.
zh: 准备好了吗，新手？我们来弄清楚。
speaker: Fix-It Felix Jr.

en: We can figure this out.
zh: 我们能想出办法的。
speaker: Pacha

en: We can work this out.
zh: 我们能把这件事解决的。
speaker: Flynn Rider / Eugene

en: I found out what's happening.
zh: 我查清楚是怎么回事了。
speaker: Judy Hopps

en: I have finally figured out what is wrong with you.
zh: 我终于弄明白你的问题出在哪儿了。
speaker: Prince Naveen (to Tiana)

en: What if Jasmine finds out? I'd lose her.
zh: 要是茉莉发现了怎么办？我会失去她的。
speaker: Aladdin
